judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across all provider rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` while preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage and ignoring intermediate missing usage. It fulfills every acceptance criterion, including testing two tool rounds (three provider calls), leaving the existing single-round test untouched, updating the spec and CHANGELOG, and making the hook signature unambiguous. To clarify the signature, the candidate introduced a type alias `AggregatedUsageMetadata = UsageMetadata` exported through `src/types/ai.ts` and `src/index.ts`, whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter from `usage` to `totalUsage` and synced `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` doc-blocks. The candidate also placed its primary acceptance tests in a new `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus one test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) rather than keeping all tests exclusively in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and left the aggregate behavior note under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving it to the main spec section.
